newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal raises over $2 billion from utility sale.
newsitem.headline: Portugal raises over $2 billion from utility sale.

text.p: The Portuguese government had its biggest ever payday from privatisations on Monday when it earned over $2.0 billion from the floating of a 30 percent stake in utility concern EDP-Electricidade de Portugal.
The 179 million shares on offer were priced at 2,250 escudos ($12.81), the top of the pre-sale range set by the government, the Lisbon bourse announced.
Demand exceeded supply several times over.
Some 60 percent of the stock was reserved for domestic investors, both institutional and private, with the remainder being offered to foreign investors.
Bourse officials said that orders for 31 million shares came from the United States, 22 million from Britain and 14 million from the rest of the world.

Analysts expect the price of shares in EDP, which will become by far the largest stock on the bourse, to soar after the sale as disappointed institutional investors seek to buy on the market the stock they failed to get at the privatisation. ($ = 175.5 Portugese Escudos)
